title: Che imbarazzo è mai questo!
subtitle: The Count, the Countess and Susanna: recitative from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 3
note: The Count puzzles over the day; Susanna comes to him
about: Score: the recitative “Che imbarazzo è mai questo!” (vocal score pages 205-209, 48 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
